articles.summary: FAIRFIELD, N.J., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Kearny Financial Corp. (NASDAQ GS: KRNY) (the “Company”), the holding company of Kearny Bank (the “Bank”), reported net income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 of $10.0 million, or $0.16 per diluted share, compared to $7.2 million, or $0.11 per diluted share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company also announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.11 per share, payable on November 18, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 4, 2026. Craig L. Montanaro, President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “We are pleased to report continued progress this quarter, reflecting ongoing execution of our strategic plan, solid loan and deposit growth, and disciplined expense management. articles.title: Kearny Financial Corp. Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results and Declaration of Cash Dividend

articles.summary: A nonprofit banking team has been launched by Kearny Bank to serve nonprofit organizations as well as charter and independent schools throughout New Jersey. The team emphasizes specialized banking solutions and financial expertise.
articles.title: New Nonprofit Banking Team Providing Specialized Financial Solutions to NJ Organizations & Schools
